_meta.sanyu/returns_en: per-pathway ES/NES/p/fdr, n_gene_sets, significant, engine, p_floor

description: GSEA gene set enrichment / GSEA 基因集富集分析 | USE WHEN: the user has a ranked gene list (e.g. DEGs sorted by log2FC) and wants to know which pathways are coordinately up- or down-regulated | ALIASES: GSEA, 基因集富集, 富集分析, 通路富集, NES, ES, 置换检验, gene set enrichment, ranked list, pathway | RETURNS: results（ES/NES/p_value/fdr 逐通路）、n_gene_sets、significant、engine（local_msigdb 或 hardcoded_50）、p_floor、方法学与图注段落

n_perm.description: 置换次数，默认 200；P 值下限 = 1/n_perm（返回体给出 p_floor 并说明达到下限不等于 P=0）

ranked_genes.description: 基因符号数组（HGNC 大写，至少 3 个；小写/Ensembl ID/探针 ID 会因重叠不足 3 个而报错）

ranked_scores.description: 与 ranked_genes **等长**的排序分数（如 log2FC 或 -log10P×符号）；长度不一致直接 422

name: gsea
title: GSEA gene set enrichment / GSEA 基因集富集分析
